name: Prism-DevRel
purpose: Answers which learning resources teach a facet record of the subject Prism model. Send a record index as decimal digits; it answers record and the record identifier, facet and the record's facet, then one page line per page that teaches it; refused unknown-record past the end, and error invalid-request for anything else. The pages themselves are at case-studies/uorust/.

promise.headline: Every record of the subject is taught by at least one page.
promise.detail: Give a record's index and get its identifier and the pages under case-studies/uorust/ that teach it. The Lean kernel checks that no record is left uncovered and that no page is named that does not exist.

claim: DR-01: every facet record of the subject is covered by at least one resource, and every resource a cover names is declared.

proposition.name: catalogValid
proposition.text:
catalogValid subject records resources rows :=
  everyRecordCovered subject records rows
  && coversOnlyDeclared resources rows

everyRecordCovered: one Covers row per record, in index order, each naming at least one resource
coversOnlyDeclared: every resource a row names is below the number of resources
proposition.plain: Each record of the subject has at least one page teaching it, and every page a record points to exists.

theorems.name: catalogCovered
theorems.statement: catalogValid subject records resources covers = true
theorems.how: Decided by the Lean kernel over the generated catalog during prismpm verify

theorems.name: uncoveredRecordRefused
theorems.statement: catalogValid with the first record's cover removed = false
theorems.how: Decided by the Lean kernel: the planted defect is refused

theorems.name: undeclaredResourceRefused
theorems.statement: catalogValid with a cover naming one resource past the last = false
theorems.how: Decided by the Lean kernel: the planted defect is refused

theorems.name: allBelow_sound_complete
theorems.statement: allBelow bound values = true <-> AllBelow bound values, for every bound and list
theorems.how: Boolean reflection, checked by the Lean kernel

pinned.name: coverage_dr_01, planted_defects_dr_02, pinned_subject_dr_03
pinned.what: The theorems' exact statements, the subject commit the catalog names against devrel/subjects.json, and that pages.yml regenerates the catalog with --check. String-matching tests, not theorems: a planted defect fails them.
